title: Board guest prompts:
title_short: Board guests · Three words for today
headline: Three Watsi board members stand in the hospital and say, in the moment, what Watsi is and what seeing it in person changed.
story: Tiffany sums up the day in three words: inspirational, heartwarming, and fun. Margaret calls Watsi clickable joy. Raj and Tiffany say what it is in plain words.
Seeing it in person: Margaret's pride is in the organization caring for families here; Tiffany sees that surgery changes the whole family.
As Watsi grows, the human connection is what could be lost. Margaret says it never will, and Raj thanks the donors.

bp_intro: Four clips from VIDEOS › INTERVIEWS: Margaret Mincho7659, Raj Mincho7660 and Mincho7661, Tiffany Mincho7719. Times are mm:ss from each clip's transcript. Ranges are the brief's; each row trims to its best sentence. Tracy Young and Leslie Francisco are not in the 131 transcribed clips, so the reel is three voices.

rows.visual: Tiffany on camera, standing, handheld. Start on “inspirational”. Use the retake, not the 03:28 take (“exciting”).
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1: Three words for today. Does not animate on. No logo, no name.

rows.visual: Margaret on camera, walking toward the lens.
rows.motion: Hook text off. Super from 0:04, above the captions: “Margaret Cornelius · Board Chair”. Caption Watsi (transcript: WOTC).

voice.quote: when I think of Watsi, I think of clickable joy for anyone who wants to try to get off the website without funding a patient, it's not possible.

rows.visual: Raj on camera. Trim from “a person that might live” to “gets done”.

voice.quote: a person that might live in another country that could see somebody else that needs an important medical procedure that they can actually help fund so that medical procedure gets done

rows.motion: Super: “Tiffany · Board Member”. First name only.

voice.quote: Watsi is a peer to peer crowdfunding platform for funding operations in low resource settings.

rows.visual: Cover with fresh BROLL from the board's hospital day (clips on scrub). No patient face without a release.

voice.quote: it's about this amazing organization here in Medellin that is caring for so many families and so many kids … To just be able to be here is just such a privilege.

rows.visual: BROLL: the board group with families (no patient face without a release). Back to Tiffany for the end of the line.

voice.quote: It was also really wonderful to meet the families of these kids. Obviously the kids need the operations, but we've found that, you know, it really affects the whole family.
what Watsi has always kept as it has grown is its authenticity … the human part of Watsi is always front and center.

rows.visual: Margaret on camera. Hold a beat after “connection”.

voice.quote: And I know that Watsi will never lose that human connection.

rows.visual: Raj on camera. The shortest clean sentence from his Diwali thank-you (05:20–06:53).

voice.quote: So I have a tremendous amount of gratitude for the folks that are out there supporting Watsi
